history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any cell of this experiment is read. Specimen borg-reborn-rs 0d09e318, default borg-rs core, shipped harness/borg.txt; nine arms on classes-18 at 100,000 turns (162 cells); every stair_scum arm at stair_scum_slack_per_level_percent 50 (the default) except level0 (0, the strict count of the review). The pilot is the gate, not a measurement (RULES 14, 16).
Gate: no config_error; one binary for every arm; each arm's values in params-core.json (stair_scum, stair_scum_slack_steps, stair_scum_slack_per_hp_tenths, stair_scum_max_hp (20 in byclass), stair_scum_slack_per_level_percent, kit_leash; byclass's class values for each class in settings-resolved.json, the Warrior with stair_scum 0); every cell ends in death or turn_cap, none in stall, timeout or crash; ctl plays the shipped game (stair_scum 0); in each stair_scum arm the mode acts (in byclass, never for the Warriors) (its "# Stair scum:" notes appear in the cells whose characters start under the threshold).
Reported per arm, paired by start against ctl: deaths, deaths at CL <= 2 and while max HP < 25; CL at 25k, 50k and 100k turns (milestones); starts reaching DL3 and DL5 with their first turn there (first_turn_at_depth); identical plays. Descriptive at this size; the next tier (verysmall, starts 1-45) only after the gate is checked and the owner agrees, with the arms the owner keeps.
